function_specs.name: x_malloc
function_specs.meaning: Allocate a private 32-byte semaphore object or return null without resources.

function_specs.name: memset
function_specs.meaning: Zero all fields of the private semaphore object.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaLock
function_specs.meaning: Enter a critical section after an allowed environment transition and expose its invariant.

function_specs.name: IdInsertObj
function_specs.meaning: Preserve a full ID manager on failure, or allocate and link its minimum free ID.

function_specs.name: x_free
function_specs.meaning: Release the private zeroed semaphore allocation.

function_specs.name: InitDoubleLinkList
function_specs.meaning: Initialize the supplied node as a self-linked empty list.

function_specs.name: DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter
function_specs.meaning: Insert the supplied node at a valid cut after the list node.

function_specs.name: CriticalAreaUnLock
function_specs.meaning: Exit the critical section with a restored invariant and an allowed global transition.

function_specs.name: _SemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Refine abs_semaphore_create: return -5 for allocation or capacity failure, otherwise publish an initialized semaphore with the minimum free ID, preserving the outside-critical protocol.
